faqs.who_are_you: I'm Ankush Ananth Bhat, a Full-Stack & GCP-Certified Cloud Engineer based in Mangaluru, India. I currently work as a Cloud Associate at Niveus Solutions (part of NTT Data), where I build scalable web applications and microservices on Google Cloud Platform.
faqs.what_do_you_do: I design and build full-stack web applications using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL, and deploy them on Google Cloud Platform. I'm especially strong in backend development, REST APIs, microservices architecture, and GCP services like Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, and Pub/Sub.
faqs.are_you_open_to_work: I'm not actively looking right now, but I'm always open to interesting conversations about cloud-native development, full-stack engineering, or solutions architecture. Feel free to reach out!
faqs.what_is_your_tech_stack: My primary stack is the PERN stack — PostgreSQL, Express.js, React.js, Node.js — running on Google Cloud Platform. I also work with FastAPI, Tailwind CSS, WebSockets, and microservices patterns.
faqs.are_you_gcp_certified: Yes! I earned the Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification in July 2025. It's valid until July 2028. I also hold 9 Google Cloud skill badges earned in April 2025.
faqs.where_did_you_study: I completed my Bachelor of Engineering in Information Science from Sahyadri College of Engineering & Management, Mangaluru, with Distinction. I graduated in May 2024.
faqs.how_long_have_you_been_at_niveus: I joined Niveus Solutions as a Software Engineer Intern in November 2024. I was promoted to Cloud Explorer in May 2025, and then to Cloud Associate in November 2025 — so I've been growing here for about 18 months.
faqs.what_projects_have_you_worked_on: At Niveus Solutions, I've worked on production-grade client deployments including full-stack PERN applications hosted on GCP, real-time WebSocket-powered systems, and microservices built with Node.js, Express.js, and FastAPI. During my RPA internship at EvoluteIQ, I built automation bots using UiPath and Automation Anywhere.
faqs.what_is_sosc: SOSC stands for Sahyadri Open Source Community. I served as Community Lead there for 2 years and 4 months (Dec 2021 – Mar 2024), running events, mentoring 200+ students, and fostering a culture of open-source development at Sahyadri College.
faqs.what_are_your_strongest_skills: My strongest technical skills are Google Cloud Platform, Node.js, React.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, and REST API design. On the soft skills side, I'm known for community building, mentoring, and delivering work ahead of deadlines.
faqs.how_can_i_contact_you: You can connect with me on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/ankushab, or visit my portfolio at bhatankush.onrender.com. I respond to everyone!
faqs.what_are_your_career_goals: I'm looking for challenging problems in cloud-native development, full-stack engineering, or solutions architecture — ideally where I can own something end-to-end and drive real impact.
faqs.what_programming_languages_do_you_know: My primary language is JavaScript (Node.js and React). I also know Python, Java, C++, and C — and have HackerRank and Udemy certifications to back several of these.
faqs.do_you_have_experience_with_rpa: Yes. I interned at EvoluteIQ for 3 months (Feb–Apr 2024) where I worked with UiPath and Automation Anywhere to build business process automation bots.
faqs.what_gcp_services_have_you_used: I've worked with Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Dataplex, Natural Language API, Data Loss Prevention API, and Cloud DevOps workflows on GCP.
faqs.what_is_your_education_background: B.E. in Information Science from Sahyadri College of Engineering & Management (Dec 2020 – May 2024), graduated with Distinction.
faqs.do_you_have_a_portfolio: Yes! You can check out my portfolio at bhatankush.onrender.com — it showcases projects built with React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud.
faqs.have_you_led_any_teams: Yes. As Community Lead at SOSC, I led a student community of 200+ members for over 2 years. As Vice President of Newton School (Oct 2022 – Apr 2024), I drove student engagement and shaped the coding culture at Sahyadri.
faqs.what_makes_you_different: I bring a rare combination of full-stack development expertise, a Google Cloud certification, and genuine leadership experience. I went from intern to full-time Cloud Associate at a top GCP partner (NTT Data) within 18 months — and I've led communities that gave me the ability to communicate technical ideas clearly to both engineers and non-engineers.
